## Implementation Approach
One jq program computes every figure from the `-s` array (FR-105); bash only formats. Medians are
computed in jq (`sort | .[length/2|floor]`). Hours = `(fromdate differences) / 3600`, one decimal.
Plan mode reuses code mode's brief structure; the agent is read-only by instruction and the command
performs the single write on APPROVE — the gate's evidence (`## Reviewed`) is unchanged, so
`speckit-helper.sh check-plan-review` and `ledger.sh unblock human:plan-review` need no change.

## Code Sketches
### Sketch 1: metrics jq core
**File:** `hooks/ledger.sh` (new case arm)
```bash
jq -s --arg since "$SINCE" '
  map(select($since == "" or .created >= $since)) as $e
  | ($e | map(select(.phase == "merged" or .phase == "released"))) as $m
  | ($e | map(select(.phase == "pr" or .phase == "merged" or .phase == "released" or .pr != null))) as $p
  | { entries: ($e|length), dispatched: ($e | map(select(any(.runs[]; .role=="implement"))) | length),
      prs_opened: ($p|length), merged: ($m|length),
      merge_rate: (if ($p|length) > 0 then ($m|length) / ($p|length) else null end),
      usd_total: ($e | map(.budget.usd_spent) | add // 0),
      usd_per_merged_pr: (if ($m|length) > 0 then ($m | map(.budget.usd_spent) | add) / ($m|length) else null end), … }' "${FILES[@]}"
```
### Sketch 2: plan mode brief
**File:** `commands/hef.review.md` (modify `:32-62`)
```markdown
Use the Task tool to spawn the `code-reviewer` agent with this brief, verbatim plus the three helper outputs:
> Review the PLAN, not code. You did not write it and must not look for the conversation that did. Challenge it on … six dimensions … Produce PLAN REVIEW … Verdict … Do not edit files. Report.
When it returns, relay the report unchanged; on APPROVE append `## Reviewed <date>` yourself.
```
## Constitution Compliance
- [x] 1–5: no payload under `.claude/`; no new command name; the metrics guards are mutation-tested; jq only; no sentinel (no entries → non-zero).

## Risks & Mitigations
| Risk | Impact | Mitigation |
|---|---|---|
| verify→merge hours use `updated`, which later writes move | figure drifts after post-merge edits | label says "approx."; `advance merged` is normally the last write |
| The eval's `tool_used` on Agent depends on the tool's name in the harness (`Agent`) | grader silently 0 | the llm rubric is the second grader; README notes the name |
